scripts.contract:generate: node scripts/export-contract.mjs && node --import tsx scripts/document-contract.mjs && npm run build --workspace=shared
scripts.contract:check: node scripts/export-contract.mjs --check && npm run build --workspace=shared && node --import tsx scripts/document-contract.mjs --check
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=shared && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,frontend,backend,agent "npm run dev --workspace=shared" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend" "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=agent"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=agent && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tests/e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run contract:check && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
